boards.title: Because You Know Ultimately We Will Band A Militia

Quoted lines: 'You Are Entering the Reparations Framework'; 'California Once Tried to Ban Black People.'; 'You Keep Our Most Brilliant Minds in a Perpetual Loop of Articulating and Translating the Ramifications of Your Systemic Generational Plunder.'; 'We call for radical distribution of resources because economic precarity is another form of harm.' (beside a portrait of Marsha P. Johnson); 'Rupture your guilt amnesia.'
boards.where: Gene Autry Trail, Palm Springs, between Via Escuela and Interstate 10 (Time Out). PBS SoCal notes a Rocky's Pawn Shop billboard ('Make America Great') stands opposite.
boards.promoted: Desert X 2021 (Mar 12 - May 16, 2021), held in the year Coachella was cancelled. Not a festival promo.
boards.aftermath: Temporary installation.
